::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** May 31st [1890s]  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mitchell
:::

Dear Madam
I have put it in [Mrs Matthew](people/person_1689.qmd)’s hands, whether to put in the article, or an apology.

The number of [Mothers in Council](organizations/other_82.qmd) being all arranged, it is very inconvenient, as some contributor must be put off

yours truly
C M Yonge
